x: Expansion Plus Expansion Plus is an all-in-one add-on for DayZ Expansion servers. Banking, a vehicle garage, player shops, territory rent, vehicle rentals, messaging, courier contracts, control zones, bounties and a full admin panel, all on one in-game tablet. Banking – deposits, savings with interest, group accounts, transfers, loans, and pay for time online. Garage – store and take out vehicles with their cargo, locks, a dealer, a player market, repairs, insurance and parking zones. Player shops – players place their own shop and trade by bank transfer. Territory rent – territories pay daily rent by base size. Vehicle rental and tracker – rent vehicles at traders; track your own on the map. Messages – a messenger with contacts, blocking, reports and admin calls. Courier contracts – carry crates for pay, steal other couriers' crates. Control zones
Getting started

Mod Workshop ID Why Community Framework CF 1559212036 Core framework, file access Dabs Framework 2545327648 Needed by Expansion's UI DayZ-Expansion-Licensed 2116157322 Expansion core DayZ-Expansion-Bundle 2572331007 Market, Base Building and Navigation are used Note The Expansion ATM must be on. Set "ATMSystemEnabled": 1 in profiles/ExpansionMod/Settings/MarketSettings.json . Shops, rent, banking and online pay all use the Expansion bank.

Copy @GhostzSuite into your server folder. Copy @GhostzSuite/keys/GhostzSuite.bikey into the server's keys folder. Load it last , after Expansion and after any PvE mod: -mod=@CF;@Dabs Framework;@DayZ-Expansion-Licensed;@DayZ-Expansion-Bundle;@GhostzSuite Start the server once.
Players subscribe on the Steam Workshop ID 3832964217 . The tablet, map drawing and sounds run on each player's game, so players always need the same version as the server .

Start the server once. It creates profiles/GhostzSuite/ with Settings.json . Stop the server and add your Steam64 ID to Admins : json "Admins": "76561198000000000" Start the server, join and press F8 . After that, add or remove admins in game on the SETTINGS tab. ADD MY ID adds yourself. If someone who isn't an admin presses F8, the panel shows them their Steam64 ID so they can send it to you.

Players open a shop with a Player Shop Kit . Add it to a trader: Press F8 and open MARKET . Edit a category and add an item with the classname gzs playershopkit , with a price and stock. Make sure that category is in a trader, then restart.

Key Does F7 Opens the tablet player menu F8 Admin panel admins only F9 Server info Numpad 0 Cruise control while driving Esc Closes the menu All keys can be changed under Options → Controls → Expansion Plus .

While driving a car or motorbike at 5 km/h or more, press the cruise key to hold your speed. Up / Down arrow change it by 5 km/h. The cruise key again, the brake or the handbrake turn it off. Accelerating still speeds you up, and cruise picks up again when you let go.

The tablet Press F7 to open the Expansion Plus tablet. Its HOME screen has a tile for every feature the server has turned on. Each app opens its own branded screen EP Bank, EP Garage Services, EP Retail, EP Land Registry, EP Messenger and more , and HOME at the top of any app brings you back.

HOME → SETTINGS holds each player's own choices: Tablet background – CHANGE picks one of 10 pictures. Pay from bank or cash – SWITCH BANK / CASH sets where rent and rentals are paid from. Player shops always use bank transfer. New message sound – CHANGE opens a scrolling list mouse wheel or UP / DOWN . Pick OFF , the Expansion Plus chime the default or one of 24 game sounds. PLAY previews a sound; clicking a row picks it. It's used for messages, admin answers and bounty alerts. Tip The background and message sound are saved on your own game, so they stay the same on every server running Expans

Garage → vehicle → 3D VIEW shows the vehicle in 3D with its parts fitted, plus its owner, condition, value, fluids, every part and its cargo. Drag to turn, mouse wheel to zoom. Shops and donations have a 3D button on each item showing its weight, size, capacity and description.
Bank and online pay Tablet → Banking. The bank is the player's Expansion bank, the same money the ATMs use. No ATM is needed to use it from the tablet.

Bank limit: 500,000,000 for player and group accounts setting BankMaxBalance . Expansion's own default is 100,000; Expansion Plus raises it at start-up and checks it every minute. DEPOSIT CASH / WITHDRAW CASH anywhere. Savings – a second account paying 10% every 24 hours , compounding. PUT IN SAVINGS / TAKE OUT . Group account – one per Expansion group. OPEN GROUP ACCOUNT , then any member can PAY IN or TAKE OUT , and the group sees the last moves. SEND MONEY – find any player, online or offline, and send them money from your bank. TRANSACTIONS – every payment in and out with date, time and ty

Lend – put money up as loan offers, held from your bank. Post as many as you like, ADD AMOUNT to one, or WITHDRAW it. Borrow from players – every offer, cheapest first. Take one for 1, 2, 4 or 7 days and pay it back with 35% on top . Borrow from the bank – up to 100,000 , with 50% on top , for the same times. PAY BACK NOW at any time. Otherwise, on the due date the money is taken from your bank, then your savings. Can't pay? Players are paid into their bank for time online . Setting Default Pay players for time online On Pay per hour online 500 Pay out every 60 minutes 30 = half the hourly pay every 30 minutes Tell the player On Each payment shows in the bank transactions as Online pay . Admins change these in F8 → SETTINGS → ONLINE PAY . Note If another mod on your server also pays for time online, turn one of them off so players don't get two messages.

F8 → BANKING : every rate and limit, banking on or off, bank loans and group accounts on or off, a savings cap, totals, running loans with CANCEL DEBT and the bank log. Saved in profiles/GhostzSuite/Bank.json .
Garage Tablet → Garage EP Garage Services . Store your vehicles safely, take them out where you need them, and buy, sell, repair and insure them.

STORE VEHICLE stores a vehicle of yours within 12 m , with its cargo. Park vehicle garage in the scroll menu parks the vehicle you're looking at, with the same rules. TAKE OUT brings it back at a spot you aim at, 4 to 15 m away boats need water and get double the range . Vehicles come out with the fluid levels they were parked with . Combat lock : no parking within 30 seconds of a hit or shot, or with an enemy within 100 m. Each player can own 10 vehicles by default, counting every vehicle they own anywhere.

Admins can require parking and taking out to happen in parking zones or at your territory flag. Parking and dealer zones show on the Expansion map with the parking icon, the zone's name and a ring round the zone, but they don't clutter the map legend . You get a message when you enter or leave one.

Lock vehicle / Unlock vehicle in the scroll menu look at the vehicle, press F . Auto lock after the owner has been more than 10 m away for 60 seconds . A locked vehicle offers nobody Get in , and its doors and inventory can't be opened from outside. Admins can still get in. A vehicle nobody owns becomes its first driver's when they sit in the driver's seat. Works on cars, boats and the DayZ 1.30 motorbikes. Admins can switch to Expansion car keys VehicleLockSystem = keys or turn locks off off .

Every vehicle has SHARE WITH MY GROUP: YES / NO . With YES, every member of your Expansion group can take it out, park it it stays yours and lock or unlock it. Selling, giving and insuring stay with the owner.

Dealer – buy and sell vehicles at Expansion market prices at any trader 50 m . Damage and missing parts come off the price. Player market – list a stored vehicle for other players to buy 3 listings each by default . Give a vehicle to another player.

Service What it does Service Body repair, worn part repair, fluid top-up, ruined part replacement Valet Frees a vehicle tied to a zone 10,000 Bring vehicle Brings your vehicle to you 25 m radius, 60 s cooldown Repair callout Fully repairs a broken-down vehicle where it is 25,000, fuel not included Insurance 25% of the value; get the vehicle back if it's destroyed

Admins can turn on a parking meter unused vehicles get impounded and towing vehicles left outside parking areas get towed after 120 minutes unused, with a fee and a warning . Impounded vehicles are released from the garage for their fee.
Vehicle rental and tracker

Tablet → Rentals EP Rent-a-Ride . Stand within 50 m of any trader , or rent straight into your garage and take it out later. Admins choose which market vehicles can be rented, for how long and at what price. Rentals come out full : fuel, oil, brake fluid, coolant and a charged battery , with every part. You're warned 5 minutes before the time runs out. When it ends, the vehicle is removed, so don't leave loot in it . Your rentals show on your map. One rental at a time by default.

Sit in the driver's seat and press TRACKER → TRACK THIS VEHICLE . Tracked vehicles appear on your Expansion map and follow the vehicle. Each one can be a 2D marker map only or a 3D marker map and in the world . Tracking stops by itself when the vehicle is parked, towed, impounded or destroyed, and you're told why. Up to 3 tracked vehicles by default. STOP removes one.
Player shops Players run their own shops that other players buy from and sell to.

Buy a Player Shop Kit a small wooden crate from a trader. Take it in your hands and use Place shop . A preview follows your cursor within 12 m , sitting on the terrain, with an arrow out of its front green = fine, red = not here . Turn it with the mouse wheel or Q / E , then left click to place it. Right click or Esc cancels and you keep the kit. It becomes a shipping container shop that's yours, with a marker on every player's Expansion map. Choose the marker's name and colour under MY SHOP → MAP MARKER .

Customers pay from their bank, and sellers are paid into their bank. Cash is never used. Everything customers pay goes straight into the owner's bank. Every shop starts with 100,000 in funds for buying items from players. Starting funds can be spent but never withdrawn. Owners move money with BANK → SHOP and SHOP → BANK .

Stocked items leave the map and are saved in the shop's file. A buyer gets a fresh item in their inventory or at their feet . Accepted items: Worn or better, empty, nothing attached, magazines unloaded, no spoiled food. Field Meaning Sell price What customers pay for one 0 = not for sale Buy price What the shop pays for one 0 = not buying Buy up to The shop stops buying at this much stock STOCK / TAKE at the shop moves items between your inventory and the shop. MAIL TO SHOP sends items from anywhere into your shop not within 60 seconds of combat . WHOLESALE buys stock from the Expansion market

SHOPS lists every shop with what it sells and buys, its rating and location, with tabs by Expansion trader. Open a shop from any side: stand by the container, look at it and press F . Buying and selling only work at the shop within 4 m . Anywhere else, the shop is view-only. Rate a shop 1 to 5 after trading with it. TOP SHOPS ranks them. PACK UP SHOP empty and at the shop removes it and gives the kit back.

Territory rent Every Expansion territory pays rent from the owner's bank, by the size of the base: the number of base-building assets inside it. Base-building assets Rent per day Up to 100 1,000 Up to 300 2,000 Up to 600 3,000 More 5,000 Rent is taken automatically from the owner's bank , one day at a time. If the bank can't pay, every member is warned and gets a 24-hour grace period . After that, the flag is removed . Any member can pay from Tablet → Territories PAY 1 DAY / PAY 7 DAYS , from bank or cash, up to 30 days ahead. New territories get their first day free . Players see their base s

Messages Tablet → Messages EP Messenger . The tile shows how many messages are unread. ALL PLAYERS – everyone the server has seen, online first, with a search. MESSAGE , ADD CONTACT , BLOCK or REPORT anyone. CONTACTS – your contacts, online or offline. INBOX – your conversations, newest first up to 300 characters a message . A new message pops up a notification and plays your chosen sound. Offline players are told how many they have when they join. BLOCK – blocked players can't message you. Unblock them under BLOCKED . REPORT – sends the admins your reason and your last messages with that play
Courier contracts Tablet → Contracts EP Courier Co. . Carry a crate from a pickup to a drop-off for pay.

Pick a job from the job board . Pay is per km of the route 4,000 per km by default . TAKE JOB costs a 10% deposit , returned on delivery. The Courier Cargo Crate appears at the pickup. Carry it, or put it in a vehicle not tents, barrels, clothes or the garage . Put it down within 30 m of the drop-off, look at it and use Deliver cargo F . The time limit is 4 minutes per km , plus 10 minutes.
Every running crate shows on every player's map and in the world , with the pay and the courier's name. Everyone is told when a job starts, is delivered, stolen or failed.

Anyone can deliver someone else's crate and gets 70% of the pay; the courier loses the deposit. Whoever carries a crate, rides in its vehicle or stands within 2 m of it can be hurt by other players anywhere , PvE and safe zones included. Whoever hits such a player loses their own PvE protection for 120 seconds . Members of the same Expansion group still can't hurt each other. Note Load @GhostzSuite after @Ninjins-PvP-PvE-Bundle and any other PvE mod, so courier PvP works.

Post your own delivery: the pickup is where you stand, PICK ON MAP sets the drop-off, then set the pay and POST JOB . The pay is held from your bank and a crate appears for you to fill. CANCEL refunds you before anyone takes it.
Territory control zones Tablet → Zones lists every zone, its kind, income, holder and status. Admins set zones up in F8 → CONTROL ZONES .

Zones pay their holders every 24 hours, online or offline , straight into the bank: Kind Income per 24 hours Military base 25,000 City 20,000 Town 15,000 Village 10,000 Industrial 5,000 Every extra zone a group holds adds +10% to all its zone income. Income is split between group members by default. Zones can also produce items each payout.

Stay inside for 15 minutes with nobody from another group inside. The holders being inside, or another group walking in, stops the takeover. The holders are warned when a takeover starts, stops and succeeds, and every capture is announced to the server.

Inside a zone, every player can be hurt by other players, ignoring PvE and safe-zone protection. Players get "PVP ZONE – YOU ARE VULNERABLE" when they walk in. Group members still can't hurt each other. Zones are drawn on every player's map: a pin and a ring in the zone's colour, with its name, type and holder. They don't appear in the map's marker list.

Bounties Tablet → Bounties. Admins turn bounties on in F8 → SETTINGS → BOUNTIES ; they're off by default. Post a bounty on any player: a reward from your bank 5,000 to 10,000,000 , a reason and a time limit 1 to 48 hours . New bounties go to every player's inbox with a notification. A hunter takes it by paying a 10% deposit . Kill the target and the hunter is paid reward + deposit . Run out of time and the bounty fails.

Who Marker The wanted player Red skull , seen by everyone 3D for the hunter The hunter Green skull , seen by the target and the poster Markers move every 5 seconds. The hunter and target can fight each other even on PvE servers. Each bounty shows a picture of the target in their gear.
Donations, players and server info
Near any trader 50 m , donate items you don't need, or take one free item every 5 minutes . You can't take back your own donations. A DONATIONS button also appears at the top of the trader screen.

Leaderboards rank every player by rating, kills, K/D, deaths, infected, animals, longest kill, time played or courier deliveries, with a search. Reviews – give another player 1 to 5 stars and a comment, after 30 minutes played. One review per player; saving again replaces it.

Press F9 or open Server Info on the tablet : Players online, server time and the next restart. Welcome, rules, wipes, restarts and events. Links Discord, website, store that open in your browser. Your stats and the top 5 players . Admins edit all of it in F8 → INFO .

Admin panel F8 Admins press F8 . Every change is saved on the server at once. Restock a trader F8 → RESTOCK refills an Expansion trader's stock in a couple of clicks. Open RESTOCK . Every Expansion trader in the world is listed, nearest first , with its zone and how full its stock is. Search by trader or zone name. SELECT a trader to see the stock of everything it sells red = empty, green = full . Press +10% , +20% , +50% , +75% or +100% FULL . Each item the trader sells gets that share of its max stock added, capped at the max. Static-stock items are skipped. Every restock is written to the server log. Note Expansion keeps stock per trader zone , not per trader. Restoc

profiles/ExpansionMod/Market Display name, icon, colour, starting stock % and exchange flag. Add, edit or delete items: lowest and highest price, lowest and highest stock, sell %, quantity %, attachments and variants. Items that aren't real game classes are flagged red. Troubleshooting and FAQ Most problems come from three things: the Expansion ATM being off, a player on an older version than the server, or a market edit that needs a restart. Problem Fix F8 says "Not an admin" Add the Steam64 ID it shows to Admins in Settings.json and restart Shops say the ATM is off, or rent never charges Turn on ATMSystemEnabled in Expansion's MarketSettings.json . Rent pauses while it's off; nothing is deleted Online pay not arriving Check F8 → SETTINGS → ONLINE PAY is on 1 with an amount above 0 Parking zones not on the map Check ShowMapMarkers is 1 and that players have

Can players fake money or items? No. Every price, payment, stock change and spawn is checked and done on the server. What happens to shop stock on a restart? Nothing. Stock lives in the shop's file, not in the world. Do I need to wipe to update? No. Settings and data carry over; new settings appear with their defaults. Do players need the update too? Yes. The tablet, map drawing and sounds run on each player's game, so players must have the same version as the server.
